title: PriceDecision
description: The output of the Flink pricing engine for one apartment and one target night. Written to both DynamoDB (hot path) and Iceberg (audit trail). Every field must be present so that the property manager can reconstruct exactly why a price was set, months later.

decision_component.description: One structured reason code explaining part of a pricing decision (ADR-0011 backlog #4).

code.description: Stable across specific attribute values — the specific value observed (which tier, which rating) lives in label, not in a proliferating enum.

label.description: Human-readable, carries the specific value (e.g. "Rating 4.8 vs baseline 4.0").

impact.description: Signed magnitude; unit is contextual to code's family — a signed adjustment fraction for property_* codes (e.g. +0.30 for luxury), a signed EUR gap for rule_* codes (e.g. the amount the cost floor exceeds the property reference price for rule_minimum_profitable_price).

decision_id.description: Idempotency key for Iceberg and DynamoDB sinks.

apartment_reference.description: Human-readable property code (e.g. BCN-042). Denormalised here so audit records are self-contained.

target_date.description: The specific night this price recommendation applies to (check-in date).

decided_at.description: Timestamp when the Flink job produced this decision.

cost_inputs.description: Cost snapshot used in this calculation. Aggregated by Flink from CostDefinition/CostOccurrence/CostAllocationRule (ADR-0012, ADR-0013).

total_monthly_cost_eur.description: Sum of amount_gross for all payment lines for this apartment in the billing period, regardless of concept. Informational rollup, not used directly in the formula.

available_days.description: Number of days in the billing period the apartment is available for rent (not blocked or under maintenance).

fixed_cost_eur.description: Informational only (ADR-0013) — sum of CostDefinition.behavior='fixed' lines / available_days, grouped for display, no longer read directly by the Break-Even/Profitable Floor formula (see fixed_and_allocated_costs_eur below).

variable_cost_eur.description: Informational only (ADR-0013) — sum of CostDefinition.behavior IN ('variable', 'semi_variable') lines / available_days, grouped for display, no longer read directly by the formula.

fixed_and_allocated_costs_eur.description: External spec §11's own term — fixed_cost_eur + variable_cost_eur, every non-percentage CostDefinition already allocated to a per-night figure by its CostAllocationRule. Feeds Break-Even Revenue (BER) and Minimum Profitable Revenue (MPR) directly (ADR-0013).

per_booking_cost_eur.description: Renamed from one_time_cost_eur (ADR-0013) — average (not sum) of CostAllocationRule.method='booking' lines in the period, each already the cost of one turnover. Divided by the candidate's own stay_length inside decide_price(), unchanged mechanically from before this phase.

p.description: Sum of every applicable CostDefinition.rate for this apartment/period (calculation_base IN pct_revenue/pct_adjusted_revenue), including the migrated owner-commission CostDefinition (ADR-0013 §4) — the external spec §11's own 'p'.

cost_lines_count.description: Number of payment_line events that contributed to total_monthly_cost_eur. Used to detect incomplete cost data.

cost_breakdown.description: Per-concept slice of fixed_cost_eur/variable_cost_eur/fixed_and_allocated_costs_eur above (ADR-0011 backlog #3, extended by ADR-0013) — already fully counted in those totals, reporting granularity only. One entry per payment_line.concept value with at least one matching line in this billing period; [] only if the period somehow has no lines (aggregate_cost never emits a decision without at least one).

amount_eur.description: Sum of amount_gross for this concept's matching lines / available_days — same per-day convention fixed_cost_eur/ota_related_cost_eur already use.

scope.description: This concept's CostDefinition.scope (ADR-0012/ADR-0013) — the dashboard groups cost_breakdown rows by this so a company-wide fan-out cost's contribution is visually distinct.

market_inputs.description: Market snapshot used in this calculation. From the most recent market_price event for this apartment's market area and target_date.

collected_at.description: Freshness indicator. Stale market data (>48h) should be flagged.

data_age_seconds.description: Seconds between collected_at and decided_at, computed inline at decision time. Cheaper, always-present companion to the separate data_stale side-output, which only fires past the 48h dead-man's-switch threshold (see ADR-0007).

calculation.description: Step-by-step trace of how the price was derived. Fully reproducible from the inputs above.

target_margin.description: Configured minimum profit margin (m). Set per apartment or globally. Feeds Minimum Profitable Revenue (MPR) — see profitable_floor_eur (ADR-0013).

minimum_price_eur.description: The active profitability floor for a 1-night stay — always equals profitable_floor_eur (ADR-0013 §5/§11). See los_floor_matrix for the same floor at other candidate stay lengths (per_booking_cost_eur amortizes across the stay; fixed_and_allocated_costs_eur does not, since it's already a per-night rate).

break_even_revenue_eur.description: BER = fixed_and_allocated_costs_eur / (1 - p) (external spec §11). Informational/explainability only (§14) — never itself substituted as the enforced floor; see minimum_price_eur/profitable_floor_eur (ADR-0013).

profitable_floor_eur.description: MPR = fixed_and_allocated_costs_eur / (1 - p - target_margin) (external spec §11). Always equals minimum_price_eur (ADR-0013 §5) — the floor guardrails actually enforce.

floor_policy.description: Hard/Soft floor vocabulary (ADR-0011 backlog #10, redefined by ADR-0013 §5): hard iff target_margin == 0 (break_even_revenue_eur == profitable_floor_eur), soft otherwise. No longer derived from an antelación-tiered floor_type (retired).

commission_pct.description: Cp: this apartment's own owner-commission CostDefinition.rate (ADR-0013 §4). Included in p — it scales with the final price.

commission_base.description: This apartment's owner-commission CostDefinition.revenue_base (ADR-0011 backlog #5, ADR-0013 §4, extended by ADR-0017 §1/Phase 24). total_revenue reproduces this project's pre-Phase-11 behavior exactly; the others net ota_fee/channel_manager, cleaning, laundry, and (widest) every scope='booking' concept out of the base, reducing the floor's numerator — see calculation.decision_components' revenue_base_netting entry when this happens.

days_to_arrival.description: target_date minus the date this decision was made. Recorded for audit/explainability only (ADR-0013 §5) — no longer read by the floor formula, which no longer varies by antelación.

competitiveness_discount.description: Fraction below market average to stay competitive (e.g. 0.05 = 5% below avg). Set per apartment or globally.

property_attribute_factor.description: Property Bonus/Malus multiplier applied to avg_nightly_rate_eur, derived from this apartment's quality_tier/rating/has_view/has_parking (ADR-0011 backlog #6, flink_jobs/property_attributes.py). 1.0 is neutral.

property_reference_price_eur.description: avg_nightly_rate_eur × property_attribute_factor. This apartment's market reference, before the competitiveness discount — replaces the raw segment average as the basis for market_reference_price_eur, rule_applied, and below_market_by (ADR-0011 backlog #6).

market_reference_price_eur.description: property_reference_price_eur × (1 - competitiveness_discount). The market-derived target price.

rule_applied.description: market_competitive: minimum_price_eur <= market_reference_price_eur, competitive pricing applied. minimum_floor: market_reference_price_eur < minimum_price_eur <= property_reference_price_eur, the cost floor won but the apartment is still at or below its (attribute-adjusted) market reference. minimum_profitable_price (renamed 2026-09-12, ex-"cost_protected"): minimum_price_eur > property_reference_price_eur, the cost floor pushed the price above the apartment's market reference — the property's costs are pricing it out of its own market; the only levers are lowering target_margin or discontinuing the listing (ADR-0007, ADR-0011).

los_floor_matrix.description: The same decide_price() evaluation at other candidate stay lengths (ADR-0011 backlog #1) — property_attribute_factor/property_reference_price_eur/market_reference_price_eur/below_market_by are identical across every entry (they never depend on stay_length), so they aren't repeated here. The stay_length=1 entry matches this calculation's own minimum_price_eur/rule_applied and the top-level output's suggested_price_eur/effective_margin exactly.

stay_length.description: Candidate LOS this entry evaluates, in nights.

minimum_price_eur.description: The floor at this stay_length — per_booking_cost_eur amortized across the stay, fixed_and_allocated_costs_eur unchanged (it's already per-night).

rule_applied.description: Can genuinely differ per entry — a longer stay's diluted floor can flip minimum_profitable_price into market_competitive.

suggested_price_eur.description: What this LOS candidate would be priced at.

effective_margin.description: Varies per entry — the per-night total cost this margin is computed against changes with stay_length.

decision_components.description: This candidate's own rule-decision component only (ADR-0011 backlog #4) — never the property Bonus/Malus block, which doesn't vary with stay_length and already lives once on the top-level calculation.decision_components.

Structured reason codes explaining this decision (ADR-0011 backlog #4): the four Property Bonus/Malus contributions plus the one rule-decision component for this stay_length=1 calculation, plus manual_override_applied when an override is active, plus minimum_stay_recommended/minimum_stay_not_viable when stay_length=1 is minimum_profitable_price (ADR-0011 backlog #12).

minimum_stay_recommendation.description: Minimum Stay as a profitability lever (ADR-0011 backlog #12, Phase 15) — pure post-processing over los_floor_matrix, always present. Finds the shortest candidate stay_length whose floor is no longer minimum_profitable_price, plus what a whole reservation at that length would cost and should be priced at in total.

recommended_min_stay.description: Shortest stay_length in los_floor_matrix whose rule_applied != minimum_profitable_price. null when even the longest candidate still is (a structural fixed/variable cost problem, not a one-time-cost dilution one).

floor_relief_eur.description: minimum_price_eur at stay_length=1 minus minimum_price_eur at recommended_min_stay. 0.0 when recommended_min_stay == 1 (already fine). null iff recommended_min_stay is null.

cost_per_reservation_eur.description: Total cost for a reservation of recommended_min_stay nights: fixed/variable cost recur every night, one_time_cost_eur is paid once per booking (the inverse of minimum_price_eur's per-night amortization). null iff recommended_min_stay is null.

suggested_price_per_reservation_eur.description: The recommended_min_stay candidate's own los_floor_matrix suggested_price_eur (never itself minimum_profitable_price) x its stay_length — a total reservation price already guaranteed to clear the cost floor and sit at/below the market reference. null iff recommended_min_stay is null.

channel_price_matrix.description: One entry per sales channel with an observed market rate for this night (ADR-0011 backlog #2, Phase 16) — 0 to 3 entries, since a candidate only exists once market-ingestor's channel-specific event for that channel/night has arrived. Unlike los_floor_matrix, market_reference_price_eur genuinely varies per entry here (each channel has its own real avg_nightly_rate_eur). The top-level calculation (this object's other fields) always reflects the blended/direct rate, never a channel-specific one.

platform.description: Which channel this candidate prices for. Direct booking is represented by the top-level calculation, not a 'direct' entry here.

avg_nightly_rate_eur.description: This channel's own raw market rate, as reported by market-ingestor.

commission_pct.description: This channel's commission rate (a fixed per-platform constant, ADR-0011 backlog #2) — independent of the top-level calculation.commission_pct, which only applies to the direct/blended case.

market_reference_price_eur.description: This channel's own avg_nightly_rate_eur run through the same property_attribute_factor/competitiveness_discount layers as the top-level calculation.

minimum_price_eur.description: The cost floor for this channel at stay_length=1, using this channel's own commission_pct.

rule_applied.description: Can genuinely differ per entry — a channel with a higher commission and/or a lower own market rate can tip into minimum_profitable_price while another channel in the same decision stays market_competitive.

suggested_price_eur.description: What this channel would be priced at.

effective_margin.description: This channel's own margin at its own suggested price.

decision_components.description: This candidate's own rule-decision component only, same convention los_floor_matrix entries use.

manual_override.description: Populated iff an unexpired manual override applied to this decision (ADR-0011 backlog #9, Phase 14) — a human action layered on top of the algorithmic suggestion, applied after the pricing engine runs, never itself a Revenue Management rule. null for the overwhelming majority of decisions.

override_price_eur.description: The authorized price, published in place of output.suggested_price_eur.

authorized_by.description: Free text — this project has no auth/roles system, so this is recorded for audit only, not checked (spec 14 §1).

valid_until.description: Expiry of the authorization. Cancelling a live override before this timestamp is done by updating this field, not deleting the row (spec 14 §1/§7).

expected_loss_eur.description: max(0, minimum_price_eur - override_price_eur) — zero when the override is at or above the algorithmic floor, not the raw (possibly negative) difference.

viability_status.description: External spec §13's situation/action table as an explicit classification (ADR-0016, Phase 23), evaluated priority-ordered: an active override always wins, then a persistent (30+ day) floor breach, then market_competitive (ok/demand_upside), then a min-stay or channel lever, else floor_binding.

floor_breach_days.description: Days this (apartment, target_date) has held rule_applied != market_competitive in an unbroken streak, 0 when currently market_competitive (ADR-0016 §4). Informational/audit only — viability_status is the decision surface.

pricing_strategy_version.description: Which insert-only pricing_strategies row (target_margin/competitiveness_discount) produced this decision (ADR-0018, Phase 25) — the field 'reproducibility' (external spec §28) hinges on, since this project does no historical replay (future-only, same precedent ADR-0011/ADR-0013 already established).

output.description: The recommendation the property manager sees.

suggested_price_eur.description: max(minimum_price_eur, market_reference_price_eur). The final recommended nightly rate.

effective_margin.description: (suggested_price_eur / total_cost_eur) - 1, where total_cost_eur = fixed_and_allocated_costs_eur + per_booking_cost_eur / stay_length (ADR-0013). The actual margin this price achieves.

below_market_by.description: property_reference_price_eur - suggested_price_eur (ADR-0011 backlog #6; was avg_nightly_rate_eur - suggested_price_eur before Phase 8). Positive means priced below this apartment's market reference; negative means priced above it (expected for rule_applied=minimum_profitable_price). Always computed — never null, since a price_decision is never emitted without market_inputs (ADR-0007).
